key_insight: ProofTrace identifies structural signatures associated with AI-generated proofs, while AI-reworded papers remain close to human-written papers.
engineering_relevance: Graph-based proof features offer an interpretable complement to text-based AI detectors and remain useful when wording changes.
method: Construct five cohorts spanning levels of AI involvement, including matched papers addressing the same problems.
Represent each paper as a graph of immediate proof support and extract mathematical-organization features.
Analyze feature projections, structural signatures, and detection performance under AI rewording.
evidence_signal: Across 8,281 papers, recurring AI-generated signatures included fewer externally cited results, greater reliance on intermediate conclusions, and altered connectivity; a separate detection experiment remained stable under AI rewording.
watch_item: Incomplete AI-use disclosures may blur cohort labels, so these signatures should not be treated as definitive proof of AI involvement.
paper_title: The Gold Rush in AI4Math, II: What are signatures of AI-assisted Proofs?
